scope: direct-gate arithmetic recurrence prover peak RSS on one named host; no whole-prover or other-family reliability claim
compiler_policy: one unchanged compiler digest across both splits; fresh sealed packages; no concurrent CPU-heavy jobs during timed proofs
feature: sum of padded component rows from sealed package cost-report.json
candidate: ordinary least squares of training program median prover peak RSS bytes = nonnegative intercept + nonnegative slope × padded rows; reject a negative fitted coefficient
reference: training-only OLS log median RSS versus log padded rows, frozen before validation, reported for comparison only
interval: candidate center plus/minus maximum leave-one-training-program-out absolute RSS error in bytes, then add pooled training trial-minus-own-program-median p05/p95 residuals; clamp lower to zero; empirical diagnostic interval only
selection_policy: automatic lowering remains disabled regardless of this targeted RSS gate; full wall/bytes/RSS, other families, cross-host evidence, and profile soundness equivalence remain necessary
